description: The line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" for four different model and dataset combinations across four discrete x-axis values. The x-axis lacks an explicit label and displays discrete tick marks at the values 128, 256, 512, and 1024, with no units provided. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four solid lines. The blue line with circle markers, representing "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep," begins at approximately 0.20 at x=128, increases to roughly 0.35 at x=512, and then remains relatively steady, ending at approximately 0.36 at x=1024. The orange line with square markers, representing "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," starts at roughly 0.15 at x=128, rises to approximately 0.42 at x=512, and stays flat, ending at the same value of 0.42 at x=1024. The green line with triangle markers, representing "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench," begins at approximately 0.06 at x=128, experiences an increase to roughly 0.37 at x=512, and then levels off to end at approximately 0.38 at x=1024. Finally, the red line with diamond markers, representing "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," starts at approximately 0.24 at x=128, increases to roughly 0.42 at x=512, and continues to rise to end at approximately 0.52 at x=1024.
